analysis.reasonEn: RSI exited oversold but has not yet settled above 50. MACD histogram continues to worsen in negative territory, signaling persistent weakness. ADX at 23.6 indicates an early stage of trend formation with uncertain direction. Volume ratio of 0.15 relative to 5-day average suggests low conviction in the current price action.
